Purchase options and add-ons

Introducing the SanskaTots All In One Busy Book — Complete School Readiness Activity Book for Kids Age 1 to 5.

What Makes This Book Different:

  • 24 Learning Themes
  • 135+ Velcro Stickers Book
  • 300GSM Premium Art Papers
  • Write, Wipe & Repeat Book
  • School Readiness Concepts
  • Proudly Made in India

Complete Curriculum Inside This One Book:

  • Alphabets — Capital letters, Small letters, Cursive tracing (both), 2 vocabulary words per letter, Velcro activity per letter
  • Handwriting Practice — Lines, Loops, Curves, Patterns
  • Numbers — Tracing, Number names, Identification, Velcro activity per number
  • Colors — Velcro identification activity per color
  • Shapes — Tracing + Velcro activity per shape
  • Vegetables — Visual identification
  • Fruits — Visual identification
  • Means of Transport — Velcro activity per vehicle type
  • Farm Animals — Velcro activity per animal
  • Wild Animals — Velcro activity per animal
  • Body Parts — Velcro activity per body part
  • Five Sense Organs — Concept mapping activity
  • Months of the Year — Recognition and sequence
  • Days of the Week — Recognition and sequence
  • Opposites — Concept matching
  • How Do You Feel — Emotion identification activity
  • Family Identification — Role recognition activity

The Perfect Gift For Every Occasion:
Birthday gift | Diwali gift | Baby shower gift | School admission gift | Return gift for birthday parties | Christmas gift | Raksha Bandhan gift
